summary: Implemented chain-preserving event-log rotation: FileEventLog now rotates live events into numbered .jsonl.archived files with a log.rotated genesis link, verifyDeep validates archives plus live log, storage rotate-log exposes the operation, doctor suggests rotation past the live-log threshold, and .gitattributes covers archived logs.
command: pnpm check; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/event-log.test.ts tests/runtime/cli.test.ts; pnpm test; bwrk storage rotate-log --max-bytes 999999999 --json; bwrk sync refresh --json; bwrk doctor --strict --json
